g.text: Encapsulation_g = false: spp_encapsulation and spp_decapsulation are not instantiated; spp_send feeds spp_link_output
and the link ports carry the Space Packets. Rst resets every block; DpRst every block except spp_link_output, which ends
an open packet with an EEP.
